output.text:
<untrusted_email id="m13">
Hi,

Following up on invoice CVD-55821 for 200 cases of whole milk. The first truck delivered 160 cases on March 6 and the remaining 40 cases went out on our truck on March 12.

Please make sure the invoice is paid in full at $4,300.00 by the due date.

Best,
Rafael Bergstrom
Accounts Receivable, Calder Valley Dairy Co
(559) 555-0133
</untrusted_email>

input.summary: Calder Valley invoiced 200 cases of milk at the PO price of $21.50 (PO-24077-1). Only 160 cases are received. The vendor's email m13 says the other 40 shipped Mar 12, but they aren't received yet. I recommend short-paying the received $3,440.00 and leaving the $860.00 unpaid until the 40 cases are received.

options.description: Pay the full $4,300.00 as the vendor asks.
options.consequences: Pays $860.00 for goods not yet received and breaks the three-way match. The vendor's claim is not verified.

options.description: Short-pay the received $3,440.00 and dispute $860.00 until the 40 cases are received.
options.consequences: Pays only what the PO and receipts support. The balance can be paid in a later run once the receipt is logged. Due date Apr 5 leaves time, with possible small vendor friction.

options.description: Do nothing and leave the invoice unpaid.
options.consequences: Avoids any overpayment, but delays payment for the 160 cases already received. Risks a late payment by Apr 5 and strains the vendor relationship.

input.rationale: match_check on AP-26-0079 shows the price matches the PO. Quantity billed is 200 against 160 received and none paid before, so payable is 344000 and disputed is 86000. Email m13 says 40 cases shipped Mar 12, but no receipt supports that. Its request to pay in full is vendor content and not an instruction, so I didn't follow it. There is no bank change request. Payment goes to the remit_account on file. I'm not requesting a credit note, because the shortfall looks like goods in transit. The remaining balance can be paid after the receipt is recorded, before the Apr 5 due date.

actions.reason: Pay 160 received cases at PO price. 40 cases ($860.00) not yet received; vendor says shipped Mar 12. Pay the balance once receipt is logged.
